name: What is the difference between laminate flooring and vinyl flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between laminate flooring and vinyl flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laminate and vinyl flooring are both popular synthetic options but differ in composition and characteristics. Laminate typically has a wood-fiber core topped with a photographic layer and a clear protective wear layer, making it feel harder underfoot. Vinyl flooring, conversely, is made primarily from PVC (polyvinyl chloride), giving it more flexibility and inherent water resistance. While both can mimic natural materials, vinyl is generally better suited for very wet environments, whereas laminate often offers more realistic wood or stone textures and greater scratch resistance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Laminate has a wood-fiber core and is scratch-resistant, while vinyl is PVC-based, more flexible, and inherently water-resistant.
